title: Exterior Services
headline:
Decks, fences, gutters,
and the outside punch list.
shortDescription: Deck repair and refinishing, fence repair, gutter clean and repair, light siding fixes, and exterior trim and paint — the outside punch list most homes need every two or three years.
lead: Most homes in the KC metro need a half-day of exterior work every couple of years — a sagging gate, gutters that overflow, a deck board that's gone soft, a piece of siding that came loose in a storm. Our exterior service is built for exactly that list. We're not a re-roofer or a full siding contractor, but we do all the in-between exterior work that smaller crews handle better than the big specialty shops. Same uniformed crew, branded truck, written quote, and photos at the end.

seo.title: Exterior Services — Apex Home Services · Kansas City Metro
seo.description: Deck, fence, gutter, and exterior trim repair across the Kansas City metro. Licensed and insured crew, written quote before work starts, photos at the end. Free walkthroughs.
seo.schemaDescription: Exterior home repair services including deck repair and refinishing, fence repair, gutter cleaning and repair, light siding repair, and exterior trim and paint.

sections.heading: Common exterior jobs
sections.intro: A representative — not exhaustive — list of what we handle on the outside.

items.label: Deck repair and refinishing
items.body: Board replacement, joist and ledger inspection, railing and stair repair, sand-and-stain. Full deck rebuilds when the framing is sound; full deck replacements route to a partner builder

items.label: Fence repair
items.body: Gate sag, post resets, picket and panel replacement, hardware swaps. Wood, vinyl, and chain-link. New full fence installs route to a partner fence contractor

items.label: Gutter clean and repair
items.body: Seasonal cleaning, downspout clearing, sealant and seam repair, fascia rot remediation. Gutter guard installs on existing gutters

items.label: Light siding repair
items.body: Vinyl, fiber-cement, and wood-lap siding patches. Storm-damage spot repairs, color-matched where possible. Full siding replacement is not in our scope — we'll refer you

items.label: Exterior trim and paint
items.body: Soffit and fascia repair, exterior door trim, garage trim, and small-scale exterior repaints. Pressure-washing the surface before paint is included

items.label: Storm and pre-listing fixes
items.body: Post-storm punch lists for homeowners and pre-listing exterior fixes for real estate clients. Quick turnaround when the timing is tight

sections.heading: How an exterior job goes
sections.body: Most exterior jobs follow the same arc.
items: Phone call or web request — describe the issue, send photos of the deck, fence, or affected area
Walk-around quote on-site for anything we can't price by photo; phone-quote for clear-cut small jobs
Crew arrives in a branded Apex truck with the materials listed in the quote
End-of-job walkthrough, before-and-after photos, and a 1-year workmanship warranty on repair work
